title: Design Studio Selections Returned Payment Addition for Returns on the Home Purchase Agreement
content:
A buyer whose payments have also come back unpaid on the purchase agreement carries an addition to the returned payment fee on the Design Studio Selections file. The purchase return addition is set by the deposit payments returned unpaid on the buyer's Home Purchase Agreement ledger in the last 12 months:

| Deposit payments returned unpaid on the Home Purchase Agreement ledger in the last 12 months | Purchase return addition (USD) |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 50.00 |
| Exactly one | 25.00 |
| None | Nothing |

**Records read.** The returned-payment entries on the Home Purchase Agreement ledger and their dates. Returns on the design ledger itself are not counted here.

*Hypothetical case:* one earnest money payment returned on the Home Purchase Agreement four months ago adds 25.00.
